title: TG-H3-H6 A. aestiva — final prepublication evidence gate
target: deduplicate, qualify evidence and stage cases without publication
critical_fixes: All eleven stage1 records corrected from VALIDATED to PENDING_REVIEW; no staged file may be directly imported into the canonical store.
Stage1 three multi-taxon records corrected aggregate_operation=false: mixed species in one discrete seizure does not imply aggregate across events.
Franca, Poxoréu, Votorantim, Niterói and Castelli Romani duplicate already-published events; no new records.
2019 San Nicolás: 630 versus 560 official counts refer to the same interception; quantity_count=null until reconciliation.
2013 Paraguay Neuland 211 chicks: republication dated 2015 must not create a 2015 event.
Susana 547 total animals including 219 birds called loros habladores: species-specific A. aestiva determination remains unproven.
Campo Gallo 143 'loros habladores' from official release: taxon assignment remains conditional.
Matinhos and Traipu: caged/held without documents does not demonstrate physical seizure; no asserted seized animal total.
H3-02 Americo de Campos: five specimens reported among 41 captive birds, do not count all as confiscated without confirmation.
An annual aggregate of 28 birds in Tarapacá and Operation Bocaiúva aggregate 180 A. aestiva are not unique event records.
MADES Paraguarí: watercourse inspection at Potrero is separate from bird seizure; do not assign that locality to birds.
